SEO.title: Zomaar Zomert · Free summer festival in Itterbeek
SEO.description: Three days of free summer festival on the field in Itterbeek. Friday and Saturday the line-up, Saturday pétanque, Sunday paella. Last weekend of July.

openGraph.title: Zomaar Zomert · Free summer festival in Itterbeek
openGraph.description: Three days, one tent, no tickets. Friday and Saturday live music, Saturday pétanque, Sunday paella. Last weekend of July, on the field in Itterbeek.

intro.body: Three days of summer festival on the field in Itterbeek, the last weekend of July. Live music, cold beer and the whole neighbourhood under one tent. Free for everyone, no tickets or wristbands.

bike.title: Zomaar Bike
bike.body: Mountain bike or gravel through the green western edge of Brussels. Waymarked route, food stops along the way and a terrace afterwards.

run.title: Zomaar Run
run.body: Running race over the Keperenberg. 7 or 14 km with official chip timing, starting at the tent.

paella.title: Sunday paella
paella.body: Long tables, one giant pan, the neighbours as company. Signing up in advance is required, so we can estimate portions better and cut down on waste.

petanque.title: Pétanque tournament
petanque.body: The yearly tournament, Saturday afternoon, on the field next to the tent. Signing up in advance is required, team spots are limited.

partners.heading: 100% Free.
partners.body: Zomaar Zomert stays free thanks to a whole crew of local businesses, volunteers and sponsors who keep it that way. Want to help out next summer?
